input.quote: Section 8.3 Termination. This Agreement will terminate on the earlier to occur of (a) the date upon which the last remaining Receivable is paid in full, settled, sold or written off and any amounts received are applied and (b) the Issuer is terminated under Section 8.1 of the Trust Agreement.
input.rationale: The Agreement imposes no liquidated damages, penalty, or early-termination/minimum fee payable by our parties (the Issuer or the Depositor). Searches for "liquidated damages", "penalty", "termination fee" and "premium" return no Customer-payable amounts, and Section 8.3 terminates the Agreement on the stated events without any exit payment to Cellco. The only premium-style amounts are Make-Whole Payments, which are noteholder economics on an Optional Redemption that the Class A Certificateholder (an Originator/Cellco affiliate) elects and funds (Sections 8.1(a), 8.2(a), and the Optional Acquisition/Redemption funding conditions in p0355 and p0362); the Clean-Up Redemption is expressly make-whole-free. The Article VI indemnities run from the Servicer/Marketing Agent to us, and the dispute-resolution provision bars punitive and consequential damages awards — both in our favor. This meets the preferred position (no liquidated damages or penalties payable by Customer), so no redline is proposed.
